_note: Claude · № 14,533 14-Oct (owner: "start NASA-5 and NASA-6"; NASA assessment §3 priority 2: an operational acceptance matrix covering accounts, symbol classes, order/exit forms and adverse event sequences; claude-builder). Each cell is an (order/exit form × adverse event). covered: its receipts are existing tests that drive the real code path under that event (file + exact test title; agent/acceptance/matrix.test.js fails if a receipt no longer exists). gap: no such test was found by the 14-10 inventory; gaps are the work list of the next NASA-5 batches, never silently closed. not_applicable: the event cannot occur for that form, with the reason. This matrix is about deterministic fault receipts (implementation verified); operations validated (bounded demo runs) and financial evidence are separate states and are not claimed here.
